activity.role: Modern artist and co-founder of Cubism
activity.notes: France-associated major creative production from the documented 1904 move to Paris through continued artistic work until 1973 death in France. Includes 1907 Les Demoiselles d'Avignon, co-creation of Cubism with Braque and 1937 Guernica. Picasso was Spanish-born and not misrepresented as a French-born person; the activity links the geographical/political context where most mature work occurred, not literal continuous residence at one Paris address. No separate activity for every painting or stylistic period.

sources.citation_text: The Picasso Museum chronology establishes his Paris move in 1904, Cubism work in Paris in 1907 and continued art production through his death in 1973.
